improvements_suggested: Add a GGUF/CUDA timeout preflight that fails fast before another root-cause matrix consumes a long compute-bound slot.
Persist per-task gpu_engaged, runner_class, and model_count fields so GPU-idle and DualGPURunner claims can be made from artifact data rather than inferred after the fact.
Report synthesis-only and compute-bound wall time in separate bins so CPU/doc synthesis throughput and GPU runtime health are optimized independently.
Emit an explicit dual_gpu_not_applicable marker for single-model compute-bound tasks to keep DualGPURunner suggestions scoped to parallel model loads.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Implement GGUF/CUDA early-timeout classification for compute-bound starts.
Add artifact fields for model_count, runner_class, and GPU engagement.
Split retrospective accounting into compute-bound and synthesis-only lanes.
meta_reflection: Interpretation is constrained to the locked fields in the skeleton; although the GPU monitor snapshot was idle, the locked gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks value is false, so GPU idle is not labeled as a bottleneck here. The savings estimate is the visible 60.2-minute compute-bound slow path over 266.2 total minutes, rounded to 23%, not a measured speedup.
